commitResults.messageTitle: Move Java classes into the alpha package
commitResults.messageBody:
Alpha and Task use the default package, which makes the source layout
less clear and does not follow the project's Java coding standard.

Move both classes into the alpha package and align their documentation,
parameter names, and whitespace with the standard. Update the README
launch path so setup instructions continue to point to the application
entry point.

Tasks only store descriptions and completion state, so the chatbot
cannot distinguish todos, deadlines, or events.

Add commands to create each task type and store its relevant date and
time details. Format list entries with type markers and scheduling
information so users can distinguish tasks at a glance.

Task type data and formatting are handled in one Task class, coupling
unrelated fields and behavior.

Introduce Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses that extend Task and
override toString for type-specific display. Continue storing them in a
Task array so common operations rely on polymorphism.

Alpha.main handles both the application lifecycle and every non-exit
command. This makes the entry point longer than the recommended size
and hides its high-level control flow among command-specific details.

Extract the command dispatch into processCommand and return the updated
task count explicitly. This keeps state changes visible without adding
shared mutable state, while allowing main to read as a short sequence of
startup, input, dispatch, and exit steps.

Restore the class header Javadoc and normalize array creation spacing
so the touched file follows the project Java coding standard.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add error handling for invalid user input
Refactor error handling to use exceptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Error handling currently prints messages directly at each error site,
which spreads output formatting across the codebase and makes it hard
to keep the bot's tone consistent. This becomes unwieldy as new
commands and error cases are added.

Add a custom AlphaException class to represent chatbot-specific
errors, and rework every error site to throw it instead of printing.
The main loop catches the exception and reports it through one shared
helper, keeping output formatting in a single place.

Aligned all error messages to end with "..." to match the bot's style,
including the mark and unmark messages that previously ended with a
period. Simplified parseIndex to return a primitive int now that it
throws on invalid input, removing the earlier null-return handling.

All classes currently live flat in the alpha package, which mixes the
task data model with the application logic. As the chatbot grows, this
makes the code harder to navigate and new responsibilities harder to
place.

Move the task model classes Task, Todo, Deadline, and Event into a new
alpha.task package, keeping the source root at src/main/java. Alpha and
AlphaException remain in the root alpha package, since they serve the
whole application. Add explicit imports for the task classes in Alpha
instead of relying on package-local access.
